kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننتصب (form VIII)
# نَنْتَصِبُ (nantaṣibu) /nan.ta.sˤi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# نُنْتَصَبُ (nuntaṣabu) /nun.ta.sˤa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# نَنْتَصِبَ (nantaṣiba) /nan.ta.sˤi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# نُنْتَصَبَ (nuntaṣaba) /nun.ta.sˤa.b
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
